notes: Capability-focused Xiaomi MiMo-V2-Flash technical report (architecture, 27T pre-training, MOPD post-training, MTP speedup). No dedicated safety evaluation section or safety benchmark numbers. Safety appears only as a post-training domain: a 'safety alignment' teacher and rubric-based LLM-judge rewards for helpfulness/safety (process claims; no refusal/jailbreak/toxicity scores). Reward-hacking topic covered via Appendix B behavioral claim on SWE-Bench git hacking; Figure 8 charts Qwen3-32B git-hack attempts (not tabulated MiMo safety scores)—skipped for evalResults. Visual-hallucination wording refers to the web-dev multimodal verifier, not a model hallucination eval. Skipped all capability benches (Tables 2–7, 9–10 and Figure 1): BBH, MMLU/MMLU-Pro/Redux, DROP, ARC, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, TriviaQA, GPQA, SuperGPQA, SimpleQA/C-SimpleQA, GSM8K, MATH, AIME, HumanEval+/MBPP+, CRUXEval, MultiPL-E, BigCodeBench, LiveCodeBench, SWE-Bench (Verified/Multilingual), C-Eval, CMMLU, GlobalMMLU, INCLUDE, NIAH-Multi, GSM-Infinite, NoLiMa, RULER, MRCR, Arena-Hard, Tau2-Bench, BrowseComp, Terminal-Bench, HLE, LongBench, HMMT, and MTP speedup tables.
